Maya: quick heads up  assembling Northbridge QBR deck. need: slide owners, one-paragraph renewal snapshot, and a single-page exec ask. can we assign now?

Connor: Ill take onboarding status + rollout metrics. will include a 2-line risk note for quotas.

Elena: Ill draft the renewal snapshot and mitigation owners. plan: call out SSO, retention, quota. will post draft by Mon noon.

Ravi: Ill own the action tracker + enablement gaps slide. will keep timeline in runbook and top-3 asks in deck.

Maya: shared runbook: https://redwood.app/s/nb-qbr-runbook-v6 (appendix slide #10). final deck Tue 12pm PT, dry run Tue 3pm PT, exec Wed 11am PT.

ops-bot: QBR template version synced at 2130000100 -> /decks/templates/qbr-2025-v2.

Connor: onboarding note: 4 pilots, 2 blocked by region quota. proposed exec ask: "Approve emergency region quota for Northbridge pilots (48-72h)". adding now.

Elena: draft renewal snapshot:
"Northbridge health: 67/100. Primary risks: SSO integration timeline delaying sign-on, ambiguous retention policy impacting compliance sign-off, and region quota limits slowing pilot expansion. With targeted exec support on quota approvals and SSO resourcing, renewal odds improve materially."

Ravi: action items short (for deck):
- Elena: mitigation paragraph + owner matrix (Mon noon)
- Connor: onboarding slide + quota ask wording (Tue 10am)
- Ravi: action tracker + appendix pointer (Tue 11:30am)
- Maya: update CRM stage & coordinate dry run (Tue)

Maya: FYI  will flip SFDC to "At Risk - Exec Assist" after Elena finalizes mitigation text. also will ping Sales Ops to prep quota justification.

Connor: can infra paste the exact quota error message here? want exact wording for the appendix.

Elena: will paste mitigation copy tonight for quick review. small ask: change "48-72h" -> "~48-72 hours" for exec clarity.

Maya: timeline reminder: Tue 12pm final deck -> Tue 3pm dry run -> Wed 11am exec. if slides miss the deadline I will reassign. thanks all.

(2 reactions: :white_check_mark: :eyes:)
